{{Quote|This power, known as mechu-deru, was responsible for the creation of Belia Darzu's infamous Technobeasts, which were capable of rewriting an organism's entire genetic code.|Tam Azur-Jamin|<ref name="DTATF">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/81/indexp7.html|text=Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena|int=Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)}}</ref>}}
The '''Metanecrons''' were an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]]—[[technobeast]]s—formed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Belia Darzu]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and ''[[mechu-deru]]'', [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu created this army by means of a [[Nanovirus|technovirus]] called the [[nanogene spore]]. Contained inside a [[Belia Darzu's fortress|hidden stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], living victims from a number of different [[Species/Legends|species]] were assimilated into the Dark Lord's forces. As the leader of a [[New Sith|resurgent Sith faction]], Lord Darzu unleashed her technobeasts upon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Sictis Wars]]. At the end of this period, the [[Assassination of Belia Darzu|assassination]] of the Dark Lord ended the creation of the mutated hybrids, sabotaging her cyborg army. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, the remaining bulk of Darzu's technobeasts dwelled inside her fortress on Tython, only to be [[Mission to Tython|wiped out]] at the hands of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

==History==
===Sictis Wars===
{{Quote|She was a student of Sith alchemy; it was said she learned the secrets of mechu-deru, the ability to transform the flesh of living beings into metal and machinery. She used this power to create an army of technobeasts: organic-droid hybrids bound to her will.|Hetton, regarding Belia Darzu|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
[[File:Technobeast-NEGTD.png|thumb|left|170px|The Metanecrons consisted of machine-organic mutants called technobeasts.]]
In [[1250 BBY]],<ref name="ATLAS">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] known as [[Belia Darzu]] had assumed the mantle of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]],<ref name="END" /> becoming the leader of a [[New Sith|resurgent Sith faction]] operating during the [[Draggulch Period]].<ref name="ATLAS" /> Around this time, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu used a hidden [[Belia Darzu's fortress|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to experiment with the creation of [[Cyborg/Legends|part machine, part organic]] hybirds called [[technobeast]]s.<ref name="DBROT" /> Exploring [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and the [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] of ''[[mechu-deru]]'',<ref name="NEGD" /> Dazu concocted the [[nanogene spore]],<ref name="CSWE-NANO">{{CSWECite|II|359|nanogene spore}}</ref> a [[Nanovirus|technovirus]] capable of irreversibly transforming living victims into the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] [[mutant]]s.<ref name="NEGD" /> Inside the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] of Tython, living subjects from a number of different [[Species/Legends|species]] were exposed to the effects of the virus, including [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] and [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]].<ref name="DBROT" /> Victims of the nanogene spore were assimilated into an [[Army/Legends|army]] of technobeasts known as the Metanecrons.<ref name="END" />

The technobeasts of Belia Darzu were designed for combat, possessing arm-mounted saws and skewers,<ref name="NEGD" /> as well as [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and [[Armor/Legends|armored]] hides. In addition, the creatures were capable of dispersing the nanogene spore itself,<ref name="DBROT" /> infecting other victims with the virus and spawning additional hybrids as a result.<ref name="END" /> Imbued with the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]],<ref name="CSWE-TECH">{{CSWECite|III|227|Technobeast}}</ref> the technobeasts were bound to the will of Belia Darzu and housed inside the [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] of her fortress.<ref name="DBROT" /> The Metanecrons formed the frontline of the Dark Lord's forces during the [[Sictis Wars]],<ref name="END" /><ref name="NEGD" /> a two-[[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] subset of the [[New Sith Wars]]. In this period, the technobeasts were unleashed upon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="ATLAS" /> becoming recognized as the defining threat of the Sictis Wars. By the [[1230 BBY|final year]] of this period,<ref name="NEGD" /> Darzu's army was sabotaged following her [[Assassination of Belia Darzu|assassination]] at the hands of the secretive [[Mecrosa Order]],<ref name="END" /> ending the creation of her Sithspawn hybrids.<ref name="NEGD" />

===Remnants===
{{Quote|I need a new Master—one with the power to penetrate the defenses of Belia's stronghold and lay claim to her secrets.|Hetton|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
[[File:BeliaDarzuCropped.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Metanecrons were compelled to obey the will of Belia Darzu, even centuries after her death.]]
[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] after Belia Darzu's [[Death/Legends|death]], the remnants of the technobeast army continued to inhabit her fortress on Tython. In the absence of their creator and leader, the mutants wandered aimlessly throughout the halls of the stronghold. During this time, the creatures fell victim to the long-term degradation caused by the nanogene spore, becoming dilapidated and dysfunctional. In addition, they were drawn towards the dark side energy radiating from the [[holocron of Belia Darzu]], the final vestige of the Dark Lord's power. Compelled by a primal urge to obey their mistress even after her death, the technobeasts congregated around the holocron within the underground inner sanctum of the fortress.<ref name="DBROT" />

In [[990 BBY]], the remnants of the technobeast army were [[Mission to Tython|encountered]] by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who sought Darzu's holocron for the secrets to constructing such a device of his own. While the creatures initially ignored Bane, they immediately turned against the Sith Lord when he attempted to seize the holocron of their deceased mistress. While swarming against Darth Bane with superior numbers, the mutated cyborgs were unable to break the defenses of his [[orbalisk armor]]. In addition, their attempts to infect the Sith Lord with the nanogene spore were thwarted; the [[orbalisk]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] on Bane's armor purged the virus from his body. Despite their relentless aggression, the remnants of the technobeast army were eventually wiped out by Lord Bane.<ref name="DBROT" />

During the era of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the technobeasts of Belia Darzu were briefly mentioned in [[Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena|''Droids, Technology and the Force'']], an essay written by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tam Azur-Jamin]].<ref name="DTATF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The technobeasts of Belia Darzu were first mentioned in an adventure seed—[[The Emperor's Pawns|''The Lost Art'']]—featured in ''[[The Emperor's Pawns]]'', an article published in [[2001]]. Despite this, the creatures remained unnamed and unaffiliated with Darzu at the time.<ref name="PAWNS">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> The technobeasts and their association with Darzu were later identified as such in [[Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)|''Droids, Technology and the Force'']], a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace fan club]] article released in [[2005]].<ref name="EN-DATF">{{Blog|abelgpena|47|Endnotes for ''Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena, Part I''}}</ref> In a subsequent article called ''[[Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties]]'', the technobeasts created by Belia Darzu were referred to as "the Metanecrons".<ref name="END" />The technobeast army made their debut appearance in ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', the second volume of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="DBROT" />
